description: Least-privilege capability for the screenshot editor (label capture-editor), a normal window opened by Rust from the capture card or a Drive file's menu. It listens for capture_editor_close_requested and calls the app-defined capture_editor_* commands, which are not capability-gated: Rust hands it the picture and takes the edited one back, so it needs no fs, dialog, opener, clipboard plugin or asset protocol. core permissions only.
